 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    bg = g[0][0]

    # Locate the solid rectangular zero placeholder.
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == 0]
    if not cells:
        return g
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    ph, pw = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1

    # The colored pattern is the non-background object; mirror it horizontally
    # into the zero rectangle.
    obj = [[g[r][c] for c in range(1, 1 + pw)] for r in range(1, 1 + ph)]
    for i in range(ph):
        for j in range(pw):
            g[r0 + i][c0 + j] = obj[i][pw - 1 - j]
    return g
"
